chunks: It is narrated from the Imams عليهم السلام that they said:
"Whoever performs hajj with haram wealth will be called at the time of the talbiyah: 'No labbayka for you, My servant, and no sa'dayka for you.'"

key_terms.التَّلْبِيَةِ: the rite of proclaiming 'labbayka' during hajj
key_terms.الْأَئِمَّةِ: the Imams عليهم السلام, from whom this teaching is narrated
key_terms.حَجَّ: performed hajj, the pilgrimage to the Sacred House
key_terms.لَبَّيْكَ: the pilgrim's response of readiness and obedience before Allah
key_terms.مَالٍ: wealth or property used for the pilgrimage

ai.seo_question: What happens if someone performs hajj with haram wealth?
ai.summary: This hadith warns that hajj performed using haram wealth is spiritually rejected, even if its outward rites are completed. It emphasizes that acts of worship must be founded upon lawful means and sincere obedience to Allah.
